svg.text: Run 5: every retained birth, fixed positive affine view
195456 original observations; every numeric row painted, including overlaps.
Raw score ticks; vertical position = log10((f-m)/s+epsilon); epsilon = 1e-6.
Blue: cumulative best from these rows. Increasing affine coordinate is better.
Higher original score preferred; final leader first at G760; 7 exact tied rows.
Fixed full-source min/max and final reference; no physical ratios or cross-run ranking.
Unknown screen values are nonnumeric; full-range asinh and summary views are separate.
